item.title: Love Is A Many-Splendored Thing
item.description: A widowed doctor of both Chinese and European descent falls in love with a married American correspondent in Hong Kong during China's Communist Revolution.

item.title: Perry Mason: The Case of the Avenging Ace
item.description: An Air Force officer is convicted of murder. Perry, who is one of his appeal lawyers, finds a new witness for the defense but then this witness is murdered before he can give evidence. Paul, as usual, does the legwork while Perry handles things in the courtroom.

item.title: Nosferatu The Vampyre
item.description: A vampire leaves his castle to find a woman who resembles his lost love.

item.title: Dracula's Widow
item.description: A vampire's widow moves to Hollywood while Van Helsing's grandson searches for her.

item.title: Fright Night
item.description: When a vampire moves next door to teenager Charlie Brewster, he enlists the help of an incredulous TV horror movie host to prevent a massive killing spree.

item.title: Young Frankenstein
item.description: After inheriting the Frankenstein Castle, a doctor, who has tried all his life to distance himself from his notorious relative, finds himself drawn to the unfinished work.

item.title: Silver Streak
item.description: After witnessing a murder aboard his train, a book editor becomes the number one suspect... and the next target for the real killer.

item.title: An Affair To Remember
item.description: After a romantic ocean affair, a couple, both engaged to other people, promises to meet six months later if they're still in love.
